record.reason: Halo proposes an exact-arithmetic reasoning architecture and specialized exact-integer hardware concept. The full text notes 1024-bit rational operations exceed ordinary per-thread GPU register budgets and cause severe spilling; it proposes lazy reduction and asynchronous reduction pipelines. This highly specialized design is not validated as a practical LLM inference optimization, so its architecture link is speculative.
record.title: From Fuzzy to Exact: The Halo Architecture for Infinite-Depth Reasoning via Rational Arithmetic
